clauses.clause: The Elm host adapter SHALL use validated Haskell transport and approved host integrations
clauses.finding: Current deployed HttpMain/HttpBar/HttpPopup use the fixed typed UiHttp interface and held Haskell-owned role origins/documents. Haskell Policy/Http admits the exact bounded request before callback/dequeue. Owner decodes the entire desktop commit, all request bindings, projection and focus before forwarding its original bytes through Native.sendCommit. Native.receiveGateway validates closed desktop framing, decoder and bound reply; Backend admits typed complete commits through authenticated current-session SCM ingress. Privileged native/owner source originates in trusted Haskell callbacks, not renderer bodies. Approved host integration is the pinned Haskell/WebKit path with held generated Elm documents and separately inventoried libraries, not arbitrary JavaScript or a browser/native issuer claim.

clauses.clause: Keep GPU resources and per-frame work outside Elm messages
clauses.finding: Actual Haskell profile loads exactly three held HTTP Elm documents: controller/bar/popup. They carry semantic JSON events/actions and typed effect descriptions, not GPU objects, native FDs, texture/pixel buffers or animation-frame positions/ticks. Browser/WebKit/native renderer owns compositing and CSS animation frames. The HTTP popup explicitly refuses nonempty unqualified preview/paint effects. PreviewVisual validates opaque64hex resource references; metadata and elm-shell scheme tokens are not GPU resources or custody proofs. The seventh compiled NativePreviewRenderer root is latent/unregistered/unshipped in the current Haskell profile; its Receiver/Visual path validates domain/lease/sequence and semantic snapshots. It is not evidence of an approved current native preview producer.
